_note: Extra strangers (round 2 of the trail life job). Same format as trail_people.json; loaded by the alive2 block. Voices: build/make_trail_voices.py.

people.name: Sigrid the birdwatcher
lines: Shh. That robin has followed three people today. It doesn't like the ones who wave.
I keep a list of everything I've seen. Last night's page just says: something watching back.

people.name: Trygve the woodcutter
lines: Never stand under the creaking ones. They're not complaining, they're deciding.
I cut a tree at breakfast and by lunch there's a stump with a little smile on it. Don't ask.

people.name: Solveig with the thermos
lines: Cocoa? No? Good. It isn't for you. It's for the one who comes by at midnight.
Every winter someone leaves a mitten on the fence. Every winter, it's gone by morning. I've stopped asking who.

people.name: Knut the weather man
lines: Wind's from the north-east. That's the direction the quiet comes from.
I counted forty-one stars last night. The night before, forty-two. I'm not worried. I'm a little worried.
